overview: The Tenebrous Caverns are a sprawling subterranean wilderness shaped by resonance instability and faction infiltration.
history: The caverns formed from ancient Luclin tectonics and resonance erosion.
Akhevan scouts discovered shadow pockets and established hidden warrens.
Vampyric raiders carved infiltration tunnels toward the Depths.
Predators adapted to the darkness, creating territorial tunnel networks.
hooks: A resonance pocket destabilizes, mutating nearby wildlife.
Akhevan scouts attempt to breach a vampyric tunnel.
A predator brood expands into an Umbral Vanguard route.
A new cavern collapse reveals an entrance to the Depths.
